    // About-a-centre transforms — a rotation or a scaling conjugated by the
    // translation of its centre. The linear part is unaffected by the centre, so
    // their action on displacements is the centre-free one.

        => AffineTransform2D(Matrix3x2.CreateRotation(r.Rotation.Angle, r.Center));

    // Rotate the point about the centre.
    Transform(p: Point2D, r: RotationAbout2D): Point2D
        => r.Center + r.Center.Between(p).Transform(r.Rotation);

    // Rotate the displacement (the centre does not act on displacements).

        => v.Transform(r.Rotation);

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): r * v.
    Multiply(r: RotationAbout2D, v: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => Transform(v, r);

    // The opposite rotation about the same centre.

    //==
    // Aiming — the rotation that points an object along a direction.

    // The rotation that aims local -Z along `forward` with local +Y as close to
    // `up` as possible, matching the view-space frame of
    // CONVENTIONS.md - View space. Built from the CreateWorld basis so the
    // handedness is stated in exactly one place. Preconditions (unchecked):
    // `forward` and `up` are not parallel.
